jordan: Morning eng-sec async — drop your 3 lines (yesterday / blockers / today). I’ll be offline 2–4pm PST, ping me if emergency.

priya: Yesterday: finished IAM policy rewrite for vault rotation (PR #452). Blocker: need SRE to approve new service-account binding for staging. Today: address PR comments and run key sweep. @Sam can you review the binding?
Command I’ll run: `./scripts/key-sweep --env=staging --dry-run`

sam: On it, Priya. Quick Q — does the new policy allow `kms:Decrypt` for telemetry-lambda? I saw a deny on line 23 of the policy diff. I’ll review and reply in the PR this afternoon.

Mei: Yesterday: ran the scheduled vuln scan across staging and prod mirrors; scanner flagged two medium CVEs in openssl deps. Blocker: upgrading openssl in prod needs a canary because our quant tests show slight perf delta. Today: will prepare a canary + rollback policy. CC @Jordan.
Scanner snippet: ```
Finding: CVE-2024-XXXX
Package: openssl v1.1.1 -> recommended v1.1.1k
Severity: medium
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary created for service `vault-worker` v2.1.4 in us-west-2. Run: https://deploys.redwood/v/12345

jordan: Thanks team. Priya — once SRE approves the binding, re-run the sweep and post results. Mei — open the canary run in the rollout dashboard and attach a rollback policy (SLOs: p99 < 300ms, error rate < 0.5%). I’ll ping SRE for the binding approval. Compliance asked for rotation evidence by EOD Friday, so we need audit logs in the ticket.

priya: Ack. Will re-run sweep and upload results here. Creating tracker: ENGSEC-847 (key-sweep + evidence).

sam: Reviewed PR, left two nits and one suggestion for a scoped allow. Approving once CI passes :thumbsup:.

Mei: Canary started — 10% traffic to us-west-2 `vault-worker`. Monitoring p95/p99 and error rate for 2h. Current snapshot:
``
error rate: 0.0%
latency p95: 86ms
latency p99: 164ms
```

jordan: Great. No other blockers from me. If anything urgent, DM me. Thanks.
